summary: The change rejects scheme-relative return targets after URL normalization and adds regression coverage for relative, absolute, dot-segment, encoded-slash and encoded-backslash inputs plus a normal path control.

evidence: src/auth_hub.ts:892 checks the parsed pathname for a leading double slash or backslash and falls back to /home, so inputs such as double-slash host, triple-slash host, backslash-host, and dot-segment forms remain on the app origin.
src/auth_hub_test.ts:231-292 exercises relative and absolute same-origin forms for the escaping inputs, encoded slash and backslash variants, and a normal path with query and fragment.
The regression assertions verify both the stored auth state return target and the callback Location header, and confirm each resolved target stays on the app origin.
The normal path control asserts the path, query, and fragment are preserved unchanged.
